{{Quote|For the ultimate dessert, sample this deluxe, Cloud City-style dessert prepared with three massive scoops of Hood Family "Bespinian Best" Ice Cream&mdash;denta bean, Trammistan chocolate and beebleberry&mdash;and garnished with flavorful toppings, atomically aerated cream, crushed ettel nuts and real Ecclessis figs.|Dex's Diner menu, on its double-scoop sundae|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Tibanna split''' was a dessert found on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]<ref name="Menu" /> a floating [[City/Legends|city]] located in the [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] for which its main export was [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The dish consisted of three scoops of [[Hood Family "Bespinian Best" Ice Cream]] with a choice of [[denta bean ice cream]], [[trammistan chocolate ice cream]] or [[Beebleberry ice cream/Legends|beebleberry ice cream]]. The split was garnished with [[atomically aerated cream]], crushed [[ettel nut]]s, and [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis figs]].<ref name="Menu" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]]<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>Tibanna splits were sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 3.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tibanna_split.png|thumb|right|120px|A Tibanna split as depicted in ''Tiny Death Star'']]
Tibanna split was first mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" /> The spit was first pictured when it appeared in the [[2013]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]'', developed by [[Disney Mobile]]. It was depicted as a [[Color/Legends|blue]], green, and yellow circle in a glass dish. The Tibanna split sold for 1,800 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at the "Scoop of Hoth" food level in the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star I]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] and lasted for three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="TDS">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>
